head_commit.message:
Build and test repositories in reproducible agent environments (#129)

Agents can now use a declared base or .NET environment with an isolated
PostgreSQL service. Runs record the immutable image, check prerequisites
before starting and clean up test services afterwards. The agent never
receives the host Docker socket.

Real host acceptance is complete. Both images built successfully; SoFa
passed 27 Node, 36 .NET and 4 browser tests inside the selected
container. Its two Docker engine tests passed on the host, and SoFa's
unchanged full CI passed all 38 .NET tests. Lighthouse verification,
real container tests and this PR's CI are green.

SoFa's explicit container/host verification split is in
juangcarmona/sofa#64. [Acceptance report, logs and
screenshots](https://github.com/juangcarmona/lighthouse/blob/262195be8b594b6f3f7ada1a8f2bdba6af7c67d5/docs/process/20261027-125-execution-environments/README.md).
The report describes the limits of the cancellation test and separates
snapshot validation from the real-history security scan.

Ready for owner review. Production rollout and package release remain
after merge.

Closes #125.
